name: FVG 50% Equilibrium Entry [Manual Build] [Strict]
raw_text: FVG 50% Equilibrium Entry (New Batch 4, Strategy 4). Single timeframe: 1H (per the source). Reuses fair_value_gap()/fvg_zone() entirely -- no new detection logic. Entry: price retraces to the 50% equilibrium level of an FVG -- long on bullish FVG, short on bearish FVG. Filter: skip small/low-quality gaps (gap size < 0.1x ATR14, own default). SL = slightly beyond the FVG zone; if the FVG-producing (impulse) candle is small (< 1.5x ATR14, own default, mirrors New Batch 3 Strategy 3's opposite-direction check), use that candle's own high/low instead (0.65% buffer, cost_model-verified safe). TP = structure-based (recent high/low) -- HARD FILTER: min 1:3 RR required, skip if not met. Position sizing: standard 1% risk default (source's own 2-5%/capital-split suggestions ignored -- portfolio management, not signal logic). No session restriction.
